# integration
Blocking | Mapping | asset.asset_type_id | Required link has no source: asset_type_id | Every row in Catalogue (sample) asset needs a asset_type_id (a link to asset_type). Workshop (sample) machine has nothing that matches it, so the load will fail until someone decides the value. | Decide how to fill it: for example a small lookup list "machine row → asset_type row", or one default value. Then add it to the import.
High | Mapping | session.name | Required value has no source: name | Catalogue (sample) session.name must be filled, but no booking column matches it. | Map a source column to it, or decide a fixed value.
High | Mapping | session.time_start | Required value has no source: time_start | Catalogue (sample) session.time_start must be filled, but no booking column matches it. | Map a source column to it, or decide a fixed value.
High | Duplicates | machine → asset: serial_no → code | Duplicates would be rejected | Catalogue (sample) requires code to be unique, but Workshop (sample) serial_no has no unique rule. If two rows share a value, the import fails. | Run a duplicate check on machine.serial_no before loading.
Medium | Types | booking → session: id (integer) → uuid (uuid) | Values may not fit | integer and uuid do not fit together. | Check the longest or largest values before loading.
Medium | Types | machine → asset: id (integer) → uuid (uuid) | Values may not fit | integer and uuid do not fit together. | Check the longest or largest values before loading.

Medium | Mapping | machine_function → capability: title, enabled | Empty values would be rejected | These Workshop (sample) columns may be empty, but the matching Catalogue (sample) columns require a value. | Count empty values in the source; decide a default or filter those rows out.
Medium | Mapping | run → session: title, started | Empty values would be rejected | These Workshop (sample) columns may be empty, but the matching Catalogue (sample) columns require a value. | Count empty values in the source; decide a default or filter those rows out.

Info | Mapping | booking, run → session | Several source tables go into one target table | Rows from booking and run would be mixed in session. | Make sure you can still tell them apart, for example with a type value.

# sql
-- 1. Make the Workshop (sample) tables (SQLite) readable inside Catalogue (sample) (run once, as admin).
--    Needs the sqlite_fdw extension. Alternative: export each table to CSV and load it with COPY into staging.
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS sqlite_fdw;
CREATE SERVER source_db FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER sqlite_fdw
  OPTIONS (database '/path/to/file.db');
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS staging;
IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA main
  LIMIT TO (booking, machine, machine_function, run)
  FROM SERVER source_db INTO staging;

-- 2. Load in this order, on the TEST database, inside one transaction
BEGIN;

-- booking → session
-- not copied: machine_id, station_nr, start_at, end_at
INSERT INTO public.session (
  uuid,
  name,
  time_start,
  add_info
)
SELECT
  NULL /* TODO: id: integer and uuid do not fit together. */,
  NULL,  -- TODO: required, no source column
  NULL,  -- TODO: required, no source column
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'Workshop (sample)', 'source_table', 'booking', 'source_id', s.id)  -- keeps the original ID
FROM staging.booking s;

-- run → session
-- not copied: id, machine_id, operator_id, station_nr, settings_xml, settings_json
INSERT INTO public.session (
  name,
  time_start,
  time_end,
  add_info
)
SELECT
  s.title,
  (s.started AT TIME ZONE '<source time zone>'),  -- TODO: confirm the source time zone
  (s.ended AT TIME ZONE '<source time zone>'),  -- TODO: confirm the source time zone
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'Workshop (sample)', 'source_table', 'run', 'source_id', s.id)  -- keeps the original ID
FROM staging.run s;

-- machine_function → capability
-- not copied: machine_id, code
INSERT INTO public.capability (
  uuid,
  name,
  available
)
SELECT
  NULL /* TODO: id: integer and uuid do not fit together. */,
  s.title,
  s.enabled
FROM staging.machine_function s;

-- machine → asset
-- not copied: notes
INSERT INTO public.asset (
  uuid,
  name,
  code,
  location_id,
  description,
  asset_type_id,
  add_info
)
SELECT
  NULL /* TODO: id: integer and uuid do not fit together. */,
  s.label,
  s.serial_no,
  (SELECT x.uuid FROM location x WHERE x.name = s.room),  -- TODO: lookup by name — check the match column
  s.power_kw::text,  -- Saved as text. Works, but the target can no longer check the value.
  NULL,  -- TODO: required link to asset_type, no source column
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'Workshop (sample)', 'source_table', 'machine', 'source_id', s.id)  -- keeps the original ID
FROM staging.machine s;

-- 3. Check the results (counts, links), then:
-- COMMIT;   or   ROLLBACK;
